shots.bild: wide view of the steampunk frontier town of Messingbrunn at dawn, copper rooftops, brass towers, wooden boardwalks, thin steam rising, a dusty prairie behind the town wall
shots.bewegung: slow aerial push-in over the rooftops, steam curling upward, warm sunrise light, a distant bell chime and soft wind
shots.sprechertext: Messingbrunn, die Stadt aus Messing und Dampf.

shots.bild: wide view across a dusty prairie at dawn, a huge cloud of dust and steam on the horizon, long shadows, low golden sun
shots.bewegung: slow push-in on the horizon, the dust cloud rolls closer, a low distant rumble
shots.sprechertext: Doch an diesem Morgen bebt der Boden.

shots.bild: far away on a ridge the silhouette of an enormous eight-legged steam-powered brass automaton with a bulbous riveted boiler body, glowing amber lens eyes and a wide copper smokestack on its back, backlit by the sunrise, steam rising from its smokestack
shots.bewegung: very slow zoom-in, steam drifts, the huge silhouette stands still, deep rumbling

shots.bild: close view of the glowing amber lens eyes and riveted brass head of an enormous eight-legged steam-powered brass automaton with a bulbous riveted boiler body, glowing amber lens eyes and a wide copper smokestack on its back, steam venting from its joints
shots.bewegung: slow push-in, the amber eyes pulse, steam vents, a low mechanical growl
shots.sprechertext: Eine Spinne aus Messing, so hoch wie ein Turm.

shots.bild: townsfolk in wide-brimmed hats standing still on a wooden boardwalk, staring toward the horizon in silence, dust in the air
shots.bewegung: static shot, dust and a hat brim flutter in the wind, distant rumbling, a bell rings once
shots.sprechertext: Die Stadt hält den Atem an.

shots.bild: wide establishing shot over the town wall, an enormous eight-legged steam-powered brass automaton with a bulbous riveted boiler body, glowing amber lens eyes and a wide copper smokestack on its back larger on the horizon marching toward Messingbrunn, golden sky, empty sky in the upper third
shots.bewegung: slow gentle push-in, dust rises from the horizon, rumbling grows

shots.bild: the two sisters stand side by side in a vaulted council hall with brass chandeliers and tall arched windows, serious expressions, medium wide shot
shots.bewegung: slow dolly-in on the sisters, chandelier light flickers, the sisters stand still and look forward, murmuring crowd and echo
shots.sprechertext: Der Bürgermeister ruft die beiden Schwestern.

shots.bild: medium close-up of Elara listening gravely, a rolled blueprint held out toward her from the edge of the frame, council hall behind her
shots.bewegung: she holds a steady serious gaze, a lock of hair moves slightly, steady medium close-up, quiet room tone
shots.sprechertext: Elara und Mira sollen die Stadt retten.

shots.bild: medium close-up of Mira with a confident half smile, council hall blurred behind her
shots.bewegung: she keeps a steady confident gaze with a small smile, only her hair moves slightly, steady camera, soft room tone

shots.bild: the sisters stand side by side at a balcony railing seen from slightly behind and aside, looking out at the distant dust cloud, wind in their hair, warm light
shots.bewegung: slow orbit around the sisters, wind moves their hair and lace, they stand still, distant rumbling

shots.bild: cluttered Victorian inventor workshop with brass gears, workbenches, hanging Edison bulbs and a glowing forge, both sisters standing at a table with blueprints, wide shot
shots.bewegung: slow lateral dolly, sparks drift up from the forge, bulbs sway slightly, the sisters stand still looking at the table, warm crackle
shots.sprechertext: In der Werkstatt beginnt die Arbeit.

shots.bild: medium close-up of Elara leaning on a drafting table with a pencil resting on a blueprint of a brass coil, goggles pushed up in her hair, warm lamp light
shots.bewegung: she looks down at the blueprint with a steady gaze, small breathing movement, dust motes in the lamp light, quiet scratching sounds

shots.bild: medium shot of Mira standing beside a glowing forge with her arms at her sides, forge glow on her face
shots.bewegung: the forge glow flickers on her face, she stands still with a steady gaze, her hair moves slightly, crackling fire

shots.bild: close-up of Elara with her brass goggles resting on her forehead, determined steady gaze at the camera, warm rim light
shots.bewegung: she holds a steady gaze, a tiny breathing movement, warm light flickers softly, quiet workshop sounds

shots.bild: close-up of a blueprint of a brass coil on a workbench, scattered brass parts, a pencil and a compass, warm lamp light
shots.bewegung: slow dolly along the blueprint, dust motes drift, a small gear on the table slowly turns, soft ticking

shots.bild: a brass Tesla-style aether coil with a glowing blue crystal core on the workbench, thin blue sparks arcing between copper rings
shots.bewegung: slow orbit around the coil, blue arcs crackle between the rings, the glow pulses, rising electric hum

shots.bild: medium two-shot of the sisters standing close and talking calmly about the plan, workshop behind them
shots.bewegung: they stand still and look at each other with calm expressions, tiny head movements, steady two-shot, warm room tone

shots.bild: close-up of a glowing blue aether crystal sitting in a brass housing, light spilling over cream lace on the table
shots.bewegung: the crystal glow pulses brighter, soft rising hum, reflections shimmer on brass

shots.bild: portrait of Mira leaning back against a workbench with her arms crossed, proud steady gaze, forge glow behind her
shots.bewegung: slow push-in, she holds a steady gaze, her hair moves slightly in a warm draft, forge crackle

shots.bild: the finished aether coil mounted on a brass steam wagon, glowing blue crystal core, polished copper rings, soft steam, hero shot
shots.bewegung: slow orbit around the machine, the crystal glows steadily, steam wisps, a gentle electric hum

shots.bild: medium two-shot of the sisters standing shoulder to shoulder with proud looks, warm workshop light
shots.bewegung: they stand still with proud confident expressions, a tiny head movement, steady two-shot, warm room tone

shots.bild: heroic portrait of Elara leaning on the workshop doorframe, golden backlight, brocade and lace catching the light, calm confident gaze
shots.bewegung: slow push-in, her hair and lace lift slightly in a warm draft, golden dust motes drift

shots.bild: the brass steam wagon carrying the glowing aether coil rolling along a wooden boardwalk street, townsfolk in wide-brimmed hats stepping aside, golden morning light
shots.bewegung: tracking shot alongside the wagon, steam puffs from the chimney, the wheels turn, crowd noise and a steam whistle

shots.bild: the sisters sit side by side on the driver's bench of the steam wagon, looking ahead with determined faces, the aether coil glowing behind them
shots.bewegung: the wagon rolls on, the sisters sit still looking ahead, wind in their hair, steady medium shot, steam hiss

shots.bild: wide view from the town wall, an enormous eight-legged steam-powered brass automaton with a bulbous riveted boiler body, glowing amber lens eyes and a wide copper smokestack on its back towering over the prairie just outside the gate, dust and steam, low golden sun
shots.bewegung: slow push-in, the machine's legs move slowly in the distance, dust rises, a deep metallic rumble

shots.bild: low-angle view of a huge brass leg of an enormous eight-legged steam-powered brass automaton with a bulbous riveted boiler body, glowing amber lens eyes and a wide copper smokestack on its back slowly stepping down into the dust of the main street, wooden planks splintering, dust cloud
shots.bewegung: slow low-angle shot, the huge leg lowers into the dust, a dust cloud billows, a deep thud, planks creak

shots.bild: medium close-up of Elara standing at the aether coil control panel with brass levers, soft blue light from the side lighting her cheek, her eyes normal and natural, determined steady gaze
shots.bewegung: the blue light pulses softly on her cheek, her eyes stay normal and natural without any glow, she keeps a steady gaze, her hair lifts slightly, rising electric hum

shots.bild: a thick blue lightning arc leaps from the copper rings of the aether coil to the brass body of an enormous eight-legged steam-powered brass automaton with a bulbous riveted boiler body, glowing amber lens eyes and a wide copper smokestack on its back, blue light flooding the street
shots.bewegung: the arc crackles and strikes the machine, blue light flashes across the street, loud electric crackle, steam bursts

shots.bild: an enormous eight-legged steam-powered brass automaton with a bulbous riveted boiler body, glowing amber lens eyes and a wide copper smokestack on its back frozen mid-step, its amber lens eyes flickering and going dark, blue sparks running over its brass body
shots.bewegung: the amber eyes flicker and fade, sparks crawl over the metal, the machine stands motionless, the rumble dies away

shots.bild: an enormous eight-legged steam-powered brass automaton with a bulbous riveted boiler body, glowing amber lens eyes and a wide copper smokestack on its back sinking slowly to rest, venting long plumes of harmless white steam into the morning sky, calm light
shots.bewegung: the machine settles slowly, long white plumes of steam rise, calm rumble, bells begin to ring

shots.bild: the town square full of cheering townspeople in wide-brimmed hats, hats thrown into the air, golden light, joyful atmosphere
shots.bewegung: camera glides over the cheering crowd, hats fly up, cheering and applause

shots.bild: the sisters stand on the town hall steps while the mayor in a frock coat tips his hat toward them, crowd behind, warm light
shots.bewegung: the mayor tips his hat, the sisters smile with relief and stay still, applause rising

shots.bild: the sisters stand at the railing of an airship deck at sunset, golden light, the town and airships below, relaxed proud expressions
shots.bewegung: slow orbit around the sisters, hair and lace moving in the breeze, they stand still, wind and distant bells

shots.bild: the sisters stand shoulder to shoulder smiling warmly on the airship deck, golden backlight
shots.bewegung: they stand still smiling, soft golden light, wind in their hair, steady two-shot

shots.bild: night sky over Messingbrunn with fireworks above the brass towers, airships glowing with lanterns, reflections in the canal
shots.bewegung: fireworks burst over the skyline, airships drift past, distant cheers

shots.bild: wide final shot of Messingbrunn at dusk, calm steam over the rooftops, the dormant brass spider silhouette resting on the ridge, airships on the horizon
shots.bewegung: slow pull-back, the town lights twinkle, a gentle bell chime and soft wind
